Assertion review at the reviewed head:

- Test :60, lease.claim(): fails if the fixture cannot acquire its isolated producer lease; this establishes the intended live input rather than testing the new guard.
- Test :61, watch_state(...)[watcher_live] is True: fails if the constructed lease/process is not recognized as live; the real reader is used, not a mocked return value.
- Test :89, result[started] is False: fails on removal of the live return, restoring the unit-only startup decision; both recorded red arms show this exact failure in all 10 parameter combinations.
- Test :90, manager.starts == []: fails if service.start is reached despite the live producer, including a change that falsely returns started=false after starting a service.
- Test :91, linger_attempts == 0: fails if ensure attempts to enable lingering beside the live producer in the no-linger case.
- Test :92, fallbacks == []: fails if either unreachable-bus or linger-failure handling invokes the process arming seam despite the live producer.
- Test :93, result[watcher_live] is True: fails if the return loses or falsifies the liveness witness.
- Test :94, result[watcher] == record: fails if ensure returns a different or altered producer identity; record was independently written into the real isolated seat by the fixture and is not an argument supplied to ensure.
- Test :95, watch_state(...)[watcher] == record: fails if ensure mutates the real seat identity; it reads storage independently after ensure.
- Test :104, absent watcher_live is False: fails if isolated setup accidentally carries a producer, establishing the opposite input for the startup control.
- Test :110, result[started] is True: fails if the no-start return becomes unconditional or fails to report startup in the absent-producer case.
- Test :111, manager.starts == [(watch_unit_name(PROJECT), False)]: fails if absent-producer arming skips service.start, selects the wrong unit, restarts instead of starting, or starts more than once; the unit-name expectation uses the existing naming owner, while occurrence and restart mode are independently fixed.

No added assertion compares an output with the same mutable value passed to the function under test in a way that survives the targeted regression.

Reuse search covered producer liveness, service call recording, isolated configuration homes and lease construction. Opened owners: watch_state in reckon/crew/watch_unit.py:663, FakeWatchService and service_home in tests/test_crew_watch_ensure.py:55/90, and the foreign-seat construction in tests/test_a_quiet_foreign_producer_reads_live.py:60. RecordingService adds the distinct condition matrix and linger-attempt counter to the existing fake; the new fixture and producer helper are local test setup using the established mechanisms. No production capability is forked.

Outside scope: the reviewed run's importer logs retain four identical base/head failures; their ids remain in the source manifest's outside_scope field and were not investigated or repaired in this read-only review.
